# AppMaster

> AppMaster is a comprehensive no-code platform for building production-ready web and mobile applications without writing code.

AppMaster provides visual designers for web applications (Vue3), native mobile apps (iOS/Android), databases (PostgreSQL), and business process automation. The platform includes professional services, learning resources through AppMaster University, and a partner program for agencies and consultants.

## Key Topics

- no-code platform
- drag-and-drop builder
- web applications
- mobile applications
- business process automation
- visual database designer
- PostgreSQL
- Vue3
- iOS/Android
- workflow automation
- API integrations
- professional services
- app deployment
- visual modeling
- enterprise solutions

## Core Platform

- [AppMaster - The No-Code platform for building web & mobile apps](https://appmaster.io): AppMaster no-code platform for building production web and mobile applications.
- [Native mobile apps for your business. No code is needed. | AppMaster](https://appmaster.io/product/mobile-applications): Native mobile app builder with drag-and-drop for iOS and Android deployment.
- [Visual designer for Vue3 web applications with drag&drop | AppMaster](https://appmaster.io/product/web-applications): Vue3 web app builder with visual designer for admin panels and portals.
- [Database Visual Designer | AppMaster](https://appmaster.io/product/data-designer): Visual database designer for PostgreSQL schema creation and relationships.
- [Visual Business Process Designer with advanced features | AppMaster](https://appmaster.io/product/business-process-editor): Visual workflow builder for automating complex business processes.
